subject: Operational notification cadence & TAM coverage (RFP follow-up)
messages:
From: Lisa Byrne <lisa@greengate.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T16:12:00Z
Subject: Operational notification cadence & TAM coverage (RFP follow-up)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As part of our RFP scoring we need a compact response that covers your TAM coverage model and incident notification cadence (we'll attach as part of the vendor pack). Can you confirm the following items for GreenGate: 

- Primary TAM contact for production incidents and an alternate.
- Support hours (local PST business hours vs 24x7 TAM availability) and any differences by severity.
- Escalation ladder (who is contacted at each step, typical time-to-escalate, and executive alert thresholds).
- Phone/pager contact model for Sev1 vs Sev2 and whether you support conference bridge facilitation.
- Evidence artifacts you can provide for audits (eg. oncall rosters, handover logs, incident timelines).
- Lead time required to change TAM roster or add shadow coverage.

If you can attach a sample weekly roster and a short escalation ladder PDF that would be ideal. We need the materials to be deliverable to our procurement and SOC reviewers by Oct 20.

Thanks —
Lisa Byrne
Procurement Manager
GreenGate Capital

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Byrne <lisa@greengate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Operational notification cadence & TAM coverage (RFP follow-up)

Lisa — thanks for the clear list, appreciated. High-level summary below and I've attached two files (TAM_Roster_Q3.xlsx, Escalation_Ladder_v2.pdf) as requested. Marissa, Soojin and Karthik are on the thread to fill in operational and compliance specifics.

Quick answers:
- Primary TAM / alternate: we assign a named TAM aligned to the account; primary + 1 shadow. Named contacts provided on the attached roster.
- Coverage model: TAMs provide weekday business-hours proactive support (08:00-18:00 local) and rotate on-call for after-hours Sev1 coverage (24x7 escalation for Sev1 only).
- Escalation ladder: we use a 4-tier ladder: TAM -> Senior TAM -> On-call Eng Lead -> Engineering Duty Manager. Exec alerts are triggered for Sev1 if not resolved within 2 hours. Details in the attached PDF.
- Phone/pager: We support direct mobile escalation and a PSTN bridge for Sev1 incidents; TAMs will stand up a bridge and join within 10 minutes of escalation.
- Audit artifacts: weekly roster, signed handover notes, and anonymized incident timelines are available; we can provide redacted examples.
- Lead time for roster changes: standard notice is 7 business days for planned changes; 24 hours for emergency swap with manager approval.

We can also book a 30-min working session to walk your SOC team through the artifacts. When works for you?

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Byrne <lisa@greengate.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Operational notification cadence & TAM coverage (RFP follow-up)

Lisa / team — adding the operational detail you asked for and attaching an anonymized incident timeline for audit review (Incident_Timeline_Redacted.pdf). Answers below are written to be copy/paste-friendly for your RFP workbook.

Operational specifics (copy for RFP):
- TAM Roster: named primary and alternate provided weekly; sample roster attached (TAM_Roster_Q3.xlsx). Rosters include timezone, oncall window, and escalation phone.
- Support hours: proactive TAM coverage Mon-Fri 08:00–18:00 local (customer timezone). After-hours Sev1 support is provided 24x7 via on-call rotation (one TAM on rotation at a time); other severities handled during business hours unless escalated.
- Escalation ladder (summary):
  * Level 1 (TAM) — initial triage and notification (15 min ack target); attempts direct contact (phone + Slack).
  * Level 2 (Senior TAM / On-call Eng Lead) — takes ownership for remediation or runbook execution (30 min escalation target).
  * Level 3 (Engineering Duty Manager) — coordination with infra teams and cross-region escalation (60–90 min).
  * Level 4 (Executive Alert) — VP+ alerted for executive communications if incident meets "Critical Business Impact" or exceeds 2 hours unresolved for Sev1.
- Phone/pager & bridge behavior: on escalation TAM will: (1) call primary oncall mobile, (2) create a PSTN/WebEx bridge and invite stakeholders, (3) escalate through ladder if no acknowledgement. Bridge facilitation is included in the engagement.
- Evidence & artifacts: we provide: weekly rosters, signed handover emails, bridge logs, incident timelines (redacted), timestamped escalation emails, and optional audit-friendly exports of oncall handoffs.
- Roster change requests: submit via support portal or email to your assigned TAM; planned changes require 7 business days; emergency swaps can be processed in 24 hours with manager sign-off.

Runbook / reference links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFG-example-runbooks (folder contains runbook templates and the redacted timeline).

If helpful, I can push a short policy doc that maps your internal severity definitions to ours for the vendor pack. We should also confirm the phone numbers you want on the roster (masked in the workbook until vendor selection).

—Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Diego / Marissa — thank you, the materials look good and are exactly the level we needed. A couple of follow-ups before we close the Q&A: 

- Can you confirm retention period for oncall/bridge logs and where they are stored? Our SOC team wants 12 months of retention accessible as audit artifacts.
- For SOC2 evidence we may request direct contact with the security lead that can speak to your log-export process — is Soojin the right contact?
- Can you confirm the assigned TAM can begin account onboarding by Nov 1 if GreenGate is selected? We have a procurement cutoff on Oct 31 for initial kickoffs.

If you can confirm those three items by end of week we'll include the docs in our packet. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lisa Byrne
Procurement Manager
GreenGate Capital
